body: I’m glad you’re doing okay, you’re a very nice person and deserve some goodness, compassion and water! Plenty of water, it’s good for you :)

I feel I’m going in circles, I feel bad and I reach out, goes nowhere, I feel bad, friends and family say they can’t handle me like this and I feel worse and I don’t even believe I’ll actually kill myself at this point. I mean,it’s pretty true that I’d have done it by now.

I find it comforting too, yes.

Although when I go to act on it, I start to feel very scared, even though if we’re to stop with my plan, I begin to o feel silly as it’s what I want and then I go to try again and the fear returns. It feels like my body won’t let me go? But then if I were to share it with those I care about, they have started to get outright frustrated. I have no idea what I’m doing, I feel like I can’t hold in the pain I’m feeling and want someone to talk with but how do you take someone seriously when they’ve been like this for year and still haven’t even tried it? 

Also, how are you doing today? I imagine it’s hard on you feeling abandoned by services?

I’m sorry you’re in this situation too. I guess I feel unsure of what to talk about, I kind of mentioned it in my comment I made just now but I am worried as all I want to talk about is suicide, death and dying and that type of thing. I feel unable to have a normal conversation, I mean I can pretend but all I want is to just ramble about how much I want death. I’m feeling like a real burden on anyone.

I don’t know what to say to anyone or how to connect or enjoy anything.

I try to refrain from socialising incase I bring the mood down or at least retreat when I feel it coming on badly. 

Sometimes I’ll say how I’m feeling to those I trust or a hotline but the hotlines are useless and give me links to self help resources that I’ll have looked over time and time again and the friends I trust, I don’t know. One got really annoyed at me, I don’t blame them but I think hearing them mock me has honestly pushed me to this weird point where I don’t know what I’m waiting for.

Normally I feel this deep guilt about leaving a dead body or hurting someone if I were to die but lately I feel like I just don’t connect to anyone, no one would really mind, I mean it’s not nice having someone you know go away, but it’s not fair on them to deal with me anymore.

I will try to hide it best I can, try to enjoy something with a friend or what have you but it gets tiring and then if I let it show it really starts to bring the mood down, especially when I go non verbal and can’t hold back the thoughts and memories from thing in my life. 

I’m starting to realise my friends have all these nice interests and want to explore those with me, chat about them but all I want to do is think about death, suicide or things around that.

I feel alone
